{{Top|leg}}
The '''CareLess Club''' was a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. It had a zero-[[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] dance floor, and served mutlicolored drinks.
